🛡 Non-custodial by architecture

We can't touch your funds — by design

GROM is a routing layer. Your wallet signs and chains settle every transaction. Verify each route on-chain.

🔑 Wallet-only authSIWE signature proves ownership — we never see your private key or seed phrase.
⛓ On-chain settlementEvery swap settles in your wallet on the target chain. GROM routes; blockchains execute.
🔍 Open routingSee exactly which DEXes and bridges your quote uses before you sign. No hidden routing.
🌐 Multi-chain nativeEach chain uses its native wallet stack — Phantom for Solana, TronLink for Tron, EIP-1193 for EVM.
🔍 Verify before signingCheck the network, recipient address, route and amount before signing each transaction.

AI pulse · здоровье биржи

Проверки сервера и доступности API каждые ~90 секунд. Кэш отмечен отдельно. Зелёный статус не подтверждает исполнение сделок или работу всех пользовательских сценариев.

AI монитор · сбои пользователей

Диагностика по телеметрии, без догадок о действиях пользователя. Лента хранит прошлые сообщения; это не список нерешённых проблем. Повторная проверка читает данные и не отправляет сделки.

Frequently asked questions

DEX
GROM custodial?

No. This is a non-custodial DEX hub. Swaps go through aggregators (LiFi and others) straight to your wallet. Perpetuals margin sits on Hyperliquid. Predictions and Tokenized Stocks also settle to your address. We never hold user funds.

What can I do?

Swap — best route across many networks and 10,000+ tokens.
Perpetuals — up to 100× via Hyperliquid.
Predictions — event markets, stake from your wallet.
Tokenized Stocks — xStocks, 24/7, fractional shares.

How does Swap work?

Connect your wallet, pick tokens, compare quotes, and sign the transaction. Tokens arrive at your address — no internal GROM balance.

How do I add funds?

Send crypto to your wallet address from an external wallet. There is no deposit onto GROM — Receive shows your address.

What are the fees?

On Swap — a routing fee (shown in the quote) plus network gas. Hyperliquid, Predict, and xStocks have their own venue fees. GROM routes swaps on-chain and uses venue-native order books for supported trading products.

Is KYC required?

Not for wallet trading on GROM. You connect a wallet and sign on-chain. Third-party rails may have their own rules. Some regions may be restricted.

How do I reach a human?

Email support.grom@gmail.com or Telegram t.me/grom_finence_hub. Include the product (Swap / Perps / Predict / Stocks), public address, UTC time, tx hash, and screenshots.

Legal & risks

In brief
Responsible trading

Perpetuals, Predictions, and Tokenized Stocks carry loss risk, including leveraged liquidation. Only trade what you can afford to lose. GROM is non-custodial software — you control keys and transactions.

Terms of use

By using GROM you accept the rules on eligibility, regions, and on-chain settlement. Third-party venues and bridges are at your own risk; GROM does not custody assets or guarantee third-party uptime.

Privacy

We may process wallet address and session data for sign-in and support. Identity documents are not required for basic DEX use.
